name: TeleResilienceBench
description: Deploying large language models in telecommunications requires more than task accuracy. In realistic workflows, a model may inherit partially completed reasoning from a prior step, an upstream agent, or its own earlier generation, and must continue that reasoning even when it is already going wrong. We introduce TeleResilienceBench, a benchmark that quantifies this capability, which we term reasoning resilience, across seven telecom sub-domains drawn from the GSMA Open-Telco LLM suite.
